csv_project_name: DB for Coachella Community Resilience Center
csv_scope_of_work: City of Coachella soliciting proposers on the engineering design, construction, and operation services to construct the City of Coachella Community Resilience Center CRC Project to be undertaken by the City must be pre-qualified prior to submitting a proposal on the Project. Design-Builders are encouraged to submit pre-qualification packages as soon as possible so that they may be notified of omissions of information to be remedied or of their pre-qualification status well in advance of the proposal deadline for this Project. This Project will involve the design and remodel, and rehabilitation of a packinghouse to serve as a Community Resiliency Center. The facility consists of a one-story building, approximately grounds. Services provided at the completed building will range from: emergency operations, emergency shelter, cooling center, commercial demonstration kitchen, office space, commercial space, non-profit operations, business incubator space, classrooms, demonstration gardens, and community events. These areas will be open to all age groups and will provide recreational and education and professionalservicesto youth, teens, adults, and seniors, as well asserve as a climate resiliency and disaster response center in Citywide emergencies. The successful design/build operate team will be responsible for all aspects of design and permitting for both interior and exterior improvements, including structural, electrical, architectural, landscape and civil design and will be responsible for the successful construction of all proposed improvements. Lastly, the design build team will serve as an operational partner for the CRC facility for a minimum of two years after the completion of the structure and will have opportunities to expand upon commercial uses within the facility and develop programming in support of the non-profit and City uses.
